caption: The drawing depicts two objects, both executed in colored pencil or similar medium, with shades of brown, gold, and touches of black and silver. The top object is an octagonal wooden table with a single drawer on its front face, featuring two metal ring pull handles and a central keyhole with a metallic escutcheon. The table stands on four cabriole legs with claw-shaped feet, each fitted with a small caster wheel. A rectangular lower shelf connects the legs. The wood is illustrated with grain patterns in various brown hues. The bottom object appears to be a wooden box with a hinged lid that is propped open; the interior of the lid has a dark rectangular surface, possibly a mirror or writing surface. The box is fitted with small, curved feet similar to the table’s, two metal ring pull handles on the front, and a small central keyhole. The background is a light tan color, bordered on two sides by double-lined triangles that frame the drawing.
title: Writing or Sewing Table
